# AuroBarber product information

AuroBarber is a standalone SaaS product for barbershop operations. It is developed by Aurosoft, a software house whose main product is Aurosoft.

## Capabilities

- Manage appointments, services, professionals, and clients.
- Provide public online booking pages for individual barbershops.
- Track commissions, cash movements, payables, and projected cash flow.
- Isolate tenant data by barbershop and apply tenant-level licensing.
- Protect sensitive client contact data with encryption and controlled access.
- Create local backups of the application database and uploaded files, with optional Google Drive delivery configured by the operator.

## Site

https://barber.aurosoft.com.br/
